title: Staff question evaluation: frozen source coverage and governed answerability
question_wording_policy: Retain each supplied question exactly, including punctuation, spelling and repeated occurrences. Publish no author, contact, correspondence or meeting-location metadata.

rubric_stages.name: source coverage
rubric_stages.pass_meaning: Distinguish candidate material in the wider frozen corpus from complete authoritative evidence for the question and its date/regime.

rubric_stages.name: semantic coverage
rubric_stages.pass_meaning: Require the relevant neutral concepts, variants and scoped relationships; custody aliases do not supply unrelated domain coverage.

rubric_stages.name: retrieval
rubric_stages.pass_meaning: Assess retrieval against declared source identities and task scope, not keyword overlap or record counts.

rubric_stages.name: traversal
rubric_stages.pass_meaning: Require justified directed paths to definitions, conditions, exceptions and evidence; candidate chapter links are not verified Ask paths.

rubric_stages.name: context assembly
rubric_stages.pass_meaning: Inspect the actual returned package, declared requirements, missing evidence and bounded omissions; do not silently add outside material.

rubric_stages.name: provenance
rubric_stages.pass_meaning: Verify source URL, document/page hashes, literal, locator, snapshot and authority classification for each material item.

rubric_stages.name: boundaries
rubric_stages.pass_meaning: Keep ambiguity, regime, date, model-authored interpretation, extraction and missing-source limitations visible; no claimant decisions or award calculations.

rubric_stages.name: answerability
rubric_stages.pass_meaning: A pass for this snapshot means correctly exposing insufficiency; it does not mean the substantive question has been answered.
